Developing solutions for the green future of the metal industry?

Primetals Technologies is a global plant manufacturer and service partner to the metals industry and offers a wide range of career opportunities. We are pioneers, in the heart of Linz, with an extraordinary passion to lead the metals industry towards decarbonization and digitalization, contributing to a more sustainable environment. Our pioneer spirit and passion for the world of the iron and steel industry has made us to recognized pioneers in our sector.

7.800 employees worldwide, including 1.700 at the Linz site, drive our technologies and projects forward. The core competences in Linz are: Iron and steel production, continuous casting, endless strip production, rolling mill technology, automation, environmental technologies, mechatronics, lifecycle services, digital transformation and green steel. If you also have an extraordinary passion for top performance and problem solving, then become part of our global team!

Let's shape the future together! 1 Global Controlling (m/f/*) 

WHAT ARE MY RESPONSIBILITIES?

The Global Controlling department (FS GC R) in Linz is seeking a qualified Controller to support global financial steering and contribute to a broad range of controlling activities for our international organization. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with global teams and gain valuable insights into corporate financial processes. 

Tasks and responsibilities: 

 * Cost center controlling, including budgeting, forecasting and reporting of the global cost centers

 * Headquarter Controlling with the following tasks: monitoring and reporting of headquarter costs

 * Determination and coordination of the allocation of global services to the entities

 * Participation in the global corporate planning process in the reporting system (Tagetik)

 * Analysis of the consolidated monthly and quarterly financial statements, plans, and budgets

 * Preparation of various presentations for management, shareholders and other Primetals Technologies locations

 * Close collaboration with other departments (e.g., Global Accounting, IT, Strategy, Taxes) 

WHAT DO I NEED TO QUALIFY FOR THIS JOB?

 * Completed higher-level school with a focus on business administration and accounting, combined with professional experience in Controlling or a degree in Business Administration or Controlling

 * Interest in IT tools 

 * Excellent use of the MS Office suite (especially Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

 * SAP and Tagetik knowledge is an advantage

 * Precise and analytical working style with a strong affinity for numbers

 * Excellent English skills, both written and spoken 

In addition to your interest in this role - which offers many exciting insights - you will convince us on a personal level with your friendly demeanor, a high degree of initiative, commitment and strong communication skills in an intercultural environment. 

WHAT ELSE DO I NEED TO KNOW?

The minimum annual gross salary for this position under the collective agreement and assuming that all requirements are met is EUR 47.546,94 (E/00) or EUR 53.241,02 (F/00). This could rise considerably, depending on qualifications and experience. Our Pioneers at Heart receive ongoing training in a wide range of areas through the "Metals Academy". In addition, we offer further benefits: From flexible working hours and home office options to free parking and discounted lunch menus. We also offer a voluntary sixth week of holiday from the age of 50.

HOW DO I APPLY?

If you are interested in this challenging and exciting position within an international environment, then submit your application online now:
